mapper.select: SELECT sys_ai_prompt_form_id AS id, user_id AS userId, form_key AS formKey, form_name AS formName, form_icon AS formIcon, form_description AS formDescription, sys_ai_prompt_form_builtin AS builtin, form_sort AS sort, sys_ai_prompt_form_status AS status, sys_ai_prompt_form_delete AS deleted FROM sys_ai_prompt_form WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND form_key = #{formKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_ai_prompt_form SET form_name = #{name}, form_icon = #{icon}, form_description = #{description}, form_sort = #{sort}, sys_ai_prompt_form_status = 1, sys_ai_prompt_form_delete = 0 WHERE sys_ai_prompt_form_id = #{id}
